name: GA Cubers Pride 2026
information: $5 of each registration payment will go to [Lost-n-Found Youth](https://www.lnfy.org/), an Atlanta-based nonprofit organization that provides services to LGBTQ+ youth experiencing homelessness. 100% of any additional donations provided during registration beyond the $40 base fee will also go to Lost-n-Found Youth. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GACuberJacketsSpring2026#63136-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY1MjU2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7e4344cedcc0b5f7977b39f6f88737fc102d500f/Copy_of_SOUTHEAST_but_as_a_prideflag.png)
